subject: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps - Acme Corp POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & Next Steps - Acme Corp POC

Hi Alex / Samantha -

Thank you for your time this morning. Quick recap of what we heard and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of pain points
- Slow inference at peak for product search (latency spikes ~800ms) impacting user conversions.
- High per-token cost on existing endpoint; want to reduce unit $/query while keeping quality.
- Strict security/compliance requirements (SOC2 + vendor questionnaire) before procurement sign-off.

Goals
- Run a 4-week POC with a representative dataset to validate latency (<200ms median tail), cost reduction, and integration effort.
- Complete security review and procurement approvals in parallel so we can sign a contract by end of September.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level)
1) Discovery & dataset prep - Owner: Acme (Samantha) / Redwood (Marissa) - Target: Aug 6
2) POC onboarding & demo - Owner: Redwood (Nikhil) - Target: Aug 20
3) Security & questionnaire - Owner: Acme (Procurement) / Redwood (Rishi) - Target: Aug 27
4) Exec review & commercial terms - Owner: Acme (Alex) / Redwood (Marissa) - Target: Sep 10
5) Contract signature / MSA - Owner: Procurement / Redwood Legal - Target: Sep 24

Open items / asks for Acme
- Samantha: please share the sample query set + 1 week of traffic logs (anonymized) by Aug 4.
- Procurement: will you accept the vendor questionnaire as a starting point? If so, we’ll route an updated copy by EOD.

Attachments
- Redwood MAP template (redwood-map-template.xlsx) attached - I filled out the timeline above.

Next calls
- MAP review (30m) - Thu Aug 3 @ 10am PT - invite sent.

If that looks right I’ll update the MAP with the dates and owners and loop in Procurement. Thanks again - excited to get this moving.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

Marissa - thanks for the clear summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: Procurement typically needs the security questionnaire and SOC2 report before we can start a POC on vendor infra. Can you send your SOC2 cert and completed questionnaire? I attached our standard questionnaire for your team to complete.
- Decision process: The technical committee (Samantha + two eng leads) will validate results from the POC; procurement signs off on legal/compliance; final exec approval from me and the CTO.

I’m looping Procurement on this thread (procurement@acme.com). I’ve also attached the Acme vendor questionnaire - please confirm whether you can fill it out by Aug 10 so we can keep the Aug 20 onboarding date.

Also, for the POC we’ll want to include a small sample of production traffic to validate tail latency. Samantha - can you own sharing that by Aug 4?

Appreciate it - looking forward to the MAP review on Thu.

Thanks,
Alex
